about: The hosted SSF transmitter (#363): the page's four routes and the receiver's thirteen. A transmitter's id, issuer, owner key and receiver credential are generated, so every case past creation reaches one by an id that was never created; the create asks for a 1 ms idle lifetime so it is gone by the next request and replaying this file never reaches ssfTransmitterMaxInstancesPerCaller. The whole lifecycle — discovery, streams, push into the api's own inbox, poll, pause and release, verification, subjects, every credential refusal — is driven by tests/api_ssf.js.

cases.name: ssf transmitter: an empty body is refused for its JWK Set

body.error: jwks must be a JWK Set — { "keys": [ … ] } — with at least one key: the public half of the key the page signs with. A receiver verifies every SET against it.

cases.name: ssf transmitter: a JWK Set with a private member is refused

body.error: jwks.keys[0] carries d, which only a PRIVATE key has. This service publishes what it is given at jwks_uri, so it takes the public half only — the page keeps the private one and signs.

cases.name: ssf transmitter: eventsSupported that is not an array is refused

body.error: eventsSupported must be an array of at most 100 event type URIs.

cases.name: ssf transmitter: a receiver credential with whitespace is refused

body.receiverCredential: has a space in it and more

body.error: receiverCredential must be 16 to 512 characters with no whitespace — it is a bearer token the receiver presents. Leave it out and one is generated.

cases.name: ssf transmitter: an idle lifetime above the ceiling is refused

body.error: idleTtlMs 999999999 is above this service's ceiling, 1800000. A page may ask for less, never more.

cases.name: ssf transmitter: a well-formed create, with a 1 ms idle lifetime so it is gone by the next case

body.note: Point the receiver at the issuer; it discovers the rest at discoveryUrl. Give it receiverCredential as its bearer token for the stream management API. Keep ownerKey: it is how this page reads, delivers through and deletes this transmitter, and neither is shown again.
